title: Make mobile navigation a full-screen editorial index
context: The owner rejected the mobile navigation, requested a redesign with animation, then required full viewport width and height.
options: Restyle the existing compact link list
Use a full-screen numbered index with grouped controls
choice: Use large numbered links, an explicit current-route marker, grouped view controls and a contact footer in a native dialog. Lazy-load the menu and animate its surface with a short CSS fade and 8px translation.
tradeoff: The menu requires its chunk on first use. Entry and exit animation depend on modern CSS support; navigation falls back to the native dialog behavior.
